algorithm: SHA-256 keyed counter mapping, no mutable PRNG state

canonicalization.encoding: UTF-8 ASCII-only identifiers; reject non-ASCII identifiers and duplicate keys
canonicalization.json: sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False; exactly one LF; arrays ordered by specified stable IDs
canonicalization.numbers: Parse proposal decimal numeric lexemes exactly (e.g. JSON parse_float=Decimal), normalize to reduced rational {numerator,denominator}; retain integers, reject booleans as numeric. Identity preimages have no floats. Raw config file SHA is separate. Only engine payload gets one correctly rounded Python 3.12 binary64 conversion.
canonicalization.hash: SHA-256 over exact canonical bytes; identity preimage excludes its own ID/hash and timestamps; hash raw files as raw bytes independently

key.unused: empty string, never omitted; counter integer 0 except rejection sampling
key.seed: existing CALIBRATION value only; this design never derives a new seed

uniform_mapping: first 8 digest bytes unsigned big-endian q; U=q/2^64 in [0,1), exact rational, one domain-separated hash per field/key

rules.service_role_factor: 9/10+U/5; field=service_role_factor; resource_id empty, node-specific, shared by all resources for that node
rules.duration_factor: 9/10+U/5; field=duration_factor; node and resource present; resource-specific private realized durations
rules.arrival_jitter: U/10 dimensionless; service_slot j, service_group empty; other IDs empty; shared by H/L pair
rules.edge_size: explicit D03 size, no random perturbation in v1; edge_id exists in namespace but edge_size keys NOT sampled
rules.rounding: Exact rationals through estimates/realized/arrivals/deadlines; single correctly-rounded nearest ties-to-even binary64 conversion for engine payload; assert positive finite, normalize negative zero to +0; no incremental float RNG arithmetic
rules.node_scaling: 16-node a/b each base/2; independent node keys, so total realized compute need not equal 8-node service

arrivals.formula: for j=0..49: q=j//5,k=j%5; a_H=a_L=P*(5*q+k/4+U_j/10); P is config period_ms
arrivals.arrival_window: [0,W) with W=50*P ms; no service at W; no arrivals after last slot, observation continues to W and full drain; completion may precede W but run_end=max(W,last_completion)

deadlines.reference: C_est = max_root_to_sink sum_node(min_compatible estimated_duration_ms); excludes communication; DAG dynamic program, no scheduling outcome
deadlines.formula: D_g = multiplier(group) * C_est(service); positive, relative to each admitted arrival
deadlines.risk: C_est is optimistic and not a feasibility certificate; D06 independent controls mandatory

controls.H_ISOLATED: retain the same 50 H services, keys, graph, durations, deadlines; remove L; place kth H at k*G
controls.LOW_COMPETITION: retain all 100 services and private keyed values; order slot then group H,L; kth service at k*G
controls.gap: G = ceil( max_service[sum_node(max_resource(estimate*11/10)) + sum_edge(max_typepair delay(edge)) + relative_deadline] ) +1 ms; a serial topological schedule is bounded by G, but actual control must verify no overlap of services
controls.control_window: W_control=N_control*G; drain all; missing L metrics in H-only are NOT_APPLICABLE_CONTROL, never a main sample
controls.lineage: all controls reference parent-main generation identity and independently hashed derived input; changed arrivals cannot reuse main workload hash

workload_identity.plan: symbolic wlref:v1:<config_id>:s<seed_index>:<MAIN|H_ISOLATED|LOW_COMPETITION>; not a materialized workload or content hash
workload_identity.payload: ordered services/nodes/edges/compatible resources; binary64 numeric payload independently canonicalized using unchanged model canonical_bytes convention; future scientific-origin adapter required
workload_identity.hashes: artifact SHA256 computed only after future authorized generation; currently all artifact hashes null

parameter_provenance: All algorithms/distributions/values here are PROPOSED except fixed model units, method-independent keys, CALIBRATION partition and full drain.
positive_guarantee: Exact preconversion duration >=81/200 ms; final binary64 must be finite and strictly positive.
